description:
Backend-impl slice of JMAP-g7wu.2.4: implement AddChannel/RemoveChannel/UpdateChannel variants in MemoryBackend::apply_space_patch.

Cascading semantics for RemoveChannel:
- All Messages in the removed channels are also destroyed (draft §Space/set line 1117).
- Iterate the MemoryBackend's Messages store; for each Message with channel_id in the removed set, destroy it.

ULID assignment for AddChannel: generate new ChannelId.

Depends on .4.1 (SpacePatchOp enum) landing. Parallelizable with .4.3 (roles+members) and .4.5 (categories) — different match arms.
title: apply_space_patch MemoryBackend: Channel variants (with Message cascade)
